results.title: Turkish drone maker Skydagger showcases products at Mali trade fair BAMEX 2026
results.snippet:
The Mali trade fair marks the drone maker’s latest global push into the African market, following the firm’s efforts to establish a global footprint by delivering some 75,000 kamikaze drones to over 30 countries since its founding in 2024.

Skydagger is also working to establish drone manufacturing plants in five different countries.
